commands.label: Execute native consumer and assert the example result

check.py.content_utf8:
from importlib.metadata import version
import re
from pyscipopt import Model
m=Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.readProblem("hello.nl")
m.optimize()
assert m.getStatus()=="optimal",m.getStatus()
x=list(m.getVars(transformed=False))
def ix(v):
  k=re.search(r"\d+$",v.name)
  assert k,v.name
  return int(k.group())
x.sort(key=ix)
sol=m.getBestSol()
vals=[sol[v] for v in x]
assert len(vals)==13 and all(abs(round(n)-n)<1e-6 for n in vals),vals
assert bytes(round(n) for n in vals)==b"Hello, World!",[(v.name,sol[v]) for v in x]
print("Hello, World!")
print("PySCIPOpt",version("pyscipopt"),"SCIP",m.getMajorVersion(),m.getMinorVersion(),m.getTechVersion())
print([(v.name,sol[v]) for v in x])

reproduction_command: Read hello.nl with SCIP’s AMPL NL reader, optimize and decode the ordered primal variables
semantic_scope: The original generated NL file was independently read and optimized by SCIP. Its thirteen original primal variables decode to the greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
